title: HeyGen releases Avatar 6 neural digital twin model
summary: HeyGen introduced Avatar 6, an avatar generation model that builds digital twins from approximately 30 seconds of video, reference photos, and audio. The architecture supports 1080p and 2K resolution, script-aware dynamic gestures, motion prompt controls, and API access across standard and Turbo inference tiers.
research_notes:
Record and upload approximately 30 seconds of reference video footage, high-resolution portrait photos, and a clear voice sample to establish the digital twin profile.

Configure generation parameters including model tier (heygen-avatar-6 or heygen-avatar-6-turbo), target resolution (1080p or 2K), and optional motion_prompt text for specific gesture control.

Submit the spoken script or synchronized audio track via web studio or Application/Model API endpoints (specifying engine.type: 'heygen-avatar-6') to render the final video.

Use text-based motion prompts to guide gesture tone and avoid excessive motion in formal or technical presentations.

Select the Turbo variant for real-time interactive or high-volume batch rendering where latency and cost outweigh marginal 2K detail differences.
